Maria Chen: Quick design review request — SLO slider labels + GPU pool picker a11y. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/mockups — please drop quick reactions or short ideas, trying to keep this <2p. cc @Oliver (Design) @Kevin Kevin Patel: Looked through — main thing: SLO slider label 'Budget / SLO' is confusing. Users don't realize slider ties cost -> maybe split label 'Target latency (ms)' and 'Budget (USD)'. :thinking: Anya Rodriguez: Also the min/max stepper currently reads as 'Min'/'Max' — screen readers read that out of context. Suggest change to 'Min GPUs' and 'Max GPUs' and add aria-describedby linking to helper text that explains units. Sam (Product): Analytics show high pool switch rate from dropdown to search. People can't tell what 'Burst' vs 'Reserve' means in the pool chips — maybe swap word 'Burst' -> 'On-demand burst' and add tooltip: "temporary extra capacity billed per-second" :thumbsup: Oliver (Design): Agree on 'Min GPUs' / 'Max GPUs'. For SLO slider microcopy, propose a two-line helper: 'Set target P95 latency (ms). Lower = faster, higher = costlier.' Keep the main label short. Also visual note: slider thumb color contrast is borderline (~2.8:1) — needs bump to ~4.5:1 for WCAG when used standalone. I'll mock a darker thumb and a clearer focus ring. accessibility-bot: Recommendation: slider must support keyboard arrow keys with step=1, include aria-valuemin / aria-valuemax, and aria-valuetext="P95 150ms". Ensure focus indicator is visible and meets contrast. Add role="slider" and aria-label="Target latency slider". Maria Chen: Nice — small ask: can we be consistent about 'burst' phrasing across UI, copy, and API docs? If we use 'On-demand burst' in UI let's also add an alias in API docs so customers can map terms. Kevin Patel: Proposed copy variants (short): - Label: "Target P95 latency" - Helper: "Set the 95th percentile latency target. Lower = faster, higher = more cost." - Burst tooltip: "On-demand capacity that temporarily increases pool GPUs. Charged per-second." Quick approve? :+1: or drop edits. Oliver (Design): I'll send a quick patch to Figma and update hover state. Also attaching sample aria snippet for devs: ```
``` Anya Rodriguez: For keyboard users, ensure pool picker chips are reachable via arrow keys and have aria-pressed. Also add a sr-only description for the selected pool's region (e.g., "us-west2 - 8x A100 reserved"). Sam (Product): Sounds good. Can we finalize copy by EOD? I can own merging into content repo. Maria, can you update Figma and post final copy here by 5pm PST? Maria Chen: I'll update Figma and post final copy here by 5pm PST. If anyone wants to prototype keyboard behavior I can pair with eng next sprint. Thanks all! :rocket!
